name: clerk-webhook-sync
title: Clerk webhook user sync
description: Adds a users table and /api/webhooks/clerk (user.created/updated/deleted upsert/delete). Requires env CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET. After install run `pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate`.
docs: 1) pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate. 2) In the Clerk dashboard add an endpoint https://YOUR-DOMAIN/api/webhooks/clerk subscribed to user.created, user.updated, user.deleted and copy the signing secret to CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET. 3) Local dev: `clerk webhooks listen --token "$(clerk webhooks token)" --forward-to http://localhost:3000/api/webhooks/clerk` or a tunnel. The route is already public in proxy.ts.
